story.title: Background
story.body: I hold an MSc in Software Engineering from ESOFT Metro Campus, after a Higher Diploma in Science at the University of Jaffna.

story.title: Growing as an engineer
story.body: I joined Apptimus Tech as an Associate Software Engineer in 2017 and grew through Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer to Technical Lead in 2024. Along the way I built web and mobile platforms with Laravel, React, Next.js, Flutter and PostgreSQL, designed RESTful APIs and database architectures, and integrated payment, authentication, mapping and cloud services.

story.title: Leading today
story.body: As Technical Lead I lead a team of 5–7 engineers and mentor 3–5 developers, own solution architecture and system design, and have led 15+ production releases. I work closely with business stakeholders across hospitality, travel, transport, finance and education, and I drive the team's adoption of AI-assisted development and LLM integration.

story.title: Recognition
story.body: Winner of the SLASSCOM National Ingenuity Awards 2024, and of Yarl Geek Challenge Season 8 with Team mAgenda.

story.title: What's next
story.body: I'm based in Seattle, Washington, and I'm looking for Senior Software Engineer, Technical Lead or Staff Engineer roles.
